research_scope: Absolute Zero — Ki Blast Evasive / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.history_search: No prior repository research commit for Absolute Zero was found.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Absolute Zero as a Ki Blast Evasive and Counter Skill. The canonical identity therefore remains Evasive / Ki Blast.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Absolute Zero is obtained from Parallel Quest 96 — The Shadow Dragons.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies Eis Shenron as the original user, with Omega Shenron also associated with the technique.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The Evasive Skill reference lists 300 Stamina.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the evidence establishes PQ96 as the route but does not establish an Ultimate-Finish-only condition. The maintained PQ transcription lists Absolute Zero in Basic Reward, while older dedicated material describes random acquisition; the discrepancy is preserved.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The user lowers body temperature and enters a counter stance; an attacker during the active period is frozen.
verification_audit.method: Revalidated the existing batch against current Xenoverse 2-specific skill, Evasive, PQ, and historical patch-note evidence. The maintained PQ transcription supports the PQ96 reward association; older dedicated material describing random acquisition is preserved as a source conflict rather than used to invent a stricter gate.
verification_audit.canonical_integration_note: Current canonical/index records were already synchronized in the 2026-09-24 Absolute Zero-through-Assault Vanish provenance audit. This batch refresh does not manually alter the 469/469 catalogs.

records.name: Absolute Zero
records.character_source: Eis Shenron; Omega Shenron - Customize Partner
records.skill_description: Abruptly lower your body temperature and touch enemies to freeze them.
records.mechanics_notes: The user enters a stationary counter stance and an attacker during the active window is frozen. Current Xenoverse 2 reference describes about three seconds of freeze; historical patch notes document changes to hit detection and freeze timing, so exact current frames/duration remain version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ96 — The Shadow Dragons is the documented Future Warrior route. The maintained PQ transcription places Absolute Zero in Basic Reward, while older dedicated material describes random acquisition; no exact drop probability or stricter Ultimate-Finish gate is inferred.
records.pve_notes: The stance-based counter can punish close-range attacks with a freeze. Exact current timing is version-sensitive.
records.pvp_notes: The counter depends on being attacked during the active stance; historical balance changes affect hit detection and freeze timing, so no fixed frame window is promoted.
